**Discpress 1.4.3 brings back the status line** above the cards, now as one slim line.

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.4.3/discpress.html)** (about 3 MB): the whole app in one file you keep.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, and the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad.

## Changes

- **The engine's status is back:** whether the engine is ready, how many threads compression uses, and where results are kept. Version 1.4.2 had hidden it whenever all was well.
- **It always fits on one line.** On phones, the threads item drops "Auto" and, on the narrowest screens, steps aside. Warnings, such as results kept in memory, always show.

Valid discs give the same CHDs as before.
